name: Images to PDF
summary: Combine PNG, JPEG, or WebP images into a multi-page PDF — entirely in your browser.
description: Drop one or more images, reorder pages, choose fit-to-image or A4/Letter with margins, and download a PDF. WebP and other formats are converted locally. Nothing is uploaded to a server.

faqs.question: Are my photos uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. The PDF is built with pdf-lib in your browser.

faqs.question: What does Fit to image mean?
faqs.answer: Each page matches that image’s aspect ratio and pixel size (scaled to PDF points).

faqs.question: Which formats work?
faqs.answer: PNG and JPEG embed directly. WebP, GIF, and BMP are converted to PNG first via Canvas.
